tasks.design: Configure native funder sections, organisation fields and grant-coded progress tables in {GOV_PORTAL}, {DOCS}, {PROJECT} and {ERP}. Keep actual needs/budget decisions, award administration and full final checking; routine internal saves have no self-gate, while actual independent signatory review precedes each separate federal submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applications repeat organisation/budget fields and progress reports repeat recorded milestones/expenditure.
tasks.enabler_now: Native form sections and grant-coded report definitions can remove that specific repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Eligibility, credible commitments, award compliance and actual delivery require accountable judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The director rejects a project commitment that actual resources cannot support.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native grant forms and grant-coded financial/project reports can reduce repeated preparation; awards and progress require actual evidence.

assumptions: All shares/cuts are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. S1 removes only three of fifteen navigation points; eligibility reading remains. S3 removes six of twenty repeated organisation/budget-field points, retaining all new justification. S9 removes five of ten fixed-table assembly points, retaining narrative and source checks.

Actual project owners supply dated milestone status; finance owners supply grant-coded transactions with ID, period, amount/currency and posting status. Director verifies in s8; missing/mismatched data requires manual reconciliation. No award inferred from application, or completion from planned milestones.

Independent signatory shown only for an organisation whose actual existing grant process requires that separate reviewer; its four points are other-role labour and unchanged. Do not add a new approval role or self-approval. Actual different ownership reweights application/reporting branches and assigns submissions to the actual authorised signer.

Existing native forms/reports earn zero new saving. Saves and submits retain one point each with no saving; internal saves ungated. Any actual payment or project commitment enactment remains its own authorised action, with no saving inferred.
unknowns: Which funder fields repeat and which independent signing process actually applies?
research_questions: Do native fields remove repeated assembly after full grant-evidence checks?

incremental.description: Maintain current funder fields and grant-coded milestone/expenditure mappings.

approvals.approved_version: s6 exact independently reviewed final application, commitments and federal destination; edits invalidate review
s12 exact independently reviewed final progress report and federal destination; edits invalidate review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Focal baseline96 of100; high removes3 navigation+6 repeated application fields+5 progress-table points:14/96*100 minus1.5 upkeep=13.083, cap13. Low: first application to unfamiliar funder retains all eligibility navigation and new justification; only2 application-field points and3 progress-table points removed:5/96*100 minus1.5=3.708, cap3.7. Other-role signatory work excluded; saves/sends yield zero saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.design: Configure reusable selected planning-training sections in {DOCS}/{LMS}. Keep actual federal/state compatibility reading, local adaptation, complete final checking, actual training and post-training observations; ordinary internal saves stay ungated and earn no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Training materials can repeat stable planning-method sections.
tasks.enabler_now: Native section reuse reduces repeated assembly without making compatibility decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Local plans must be understood and reconciled with actual higher-level plans.
tasks.human_edge: The director identifies a local exercise answer that appears compatible but misses a practical dependency.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reusable training sections can reduce preparation; actual plan compatibility and teaching require human judgement.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Seven of twenty-five assembly points represent stable method sections; remaining eighteen cover actual local examples, updates and formatting/checks. Existing reuse earns zero new saving.

Actual plan owners supply current plans; director selects/adapts content. Outcome notes only if assigned, after actual training; remove unused branch and reweight. No attendance/competence inferred from invitation. Any actual material release is separately reviewed and sent by actual authorised owner; no saving claimed for that action.
unknowns: How much material stays stable across actual local groups?
research_questions: Can native method sections save assembly after full federal/state compatibility checks?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes7 stable-section assembly points minus0.6 upkeep=6.4. Low: a new federal/state plan forces replacement of all plan-specific sections; only4 unchanged method-section points can be reused, minus0.6=3.4. Actual local adaptation, full checking, teaching and outcome notes remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.design: Configure native funder sections and verified community fields in {GOV_PORTAL}/{DOCS}. Retain actual needs/evidence assistance and full final package checking, with an ungated routine workspace save; the community's existing authorised applicant reviews the director-authored package before separate federal submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Application assistance can repeat funding-source navigation and existing project fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native funder sections and verified reusable fields reduce repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Community priorities, eligible equipment and credible evidence require actual participants.
tasks.human_edge: The director recognises that a community's stated equipment request lacks the required project evidence.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native grant fields can support application assistance; actual community needs, evidence and commitments remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. S1 removes five of twenty navigation points, retaining all eligibility reading; s3 removes seven of twenty-eight known organisation/project-field points, retaining all new facility/radiological-instrument justification.

Community owners produce actual needs/cost/equipment evidence; director verifies and assists, never invents commitments. Existing native search/forms yield zero new saving. Actual applicant review/submission is six unchanged other-role points, excluded from focal savings.

Shared workspace is actual authorised collaboration space; if actual delivery needs a separate send, model it and its independent final-version review before recalculating, with no assumed saving. Community applicant reviews director-authored content; no director self-approval or added approval ceremony. No funding award inferred from submission.
unknowns: Which application fields and source navigation actually repeat?
research_questions: Does native field reuse reduce support effort after full community evidence checks?

tasks.design: Configure indexed actual hazard/scope/source-date links in {DOCS}, using {GOV_PORTAL} only as an actual plan source. Reduce repeated plan locating while retaining full study, local applicability judgement, new notes and ordinary ungated save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding relevant peer plans can require repeated source navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed source metadata can shorten locating without summarising away the plan.
tasks.still_hard: A plan used elsewhere may rely on resources or hazards unlike the local setting.
tasks.human_edge: The director identifies a borrowed measure that cannot work with local response capacity.
tasks.altitude: Less peer-plan locating before substantive study.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: indexed peer-plan metadata can reduce source navigation; actual plan study and local interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Six of twenty-five locating points are repeated hazard/scope filtering and source navigation; nineteen remain for source verification and finding unusual relevant material. Actual plan owners supply authentic versions; no invented sources or abbreviated scientific reading.

Existing indexed lookup earns zero new saving. Notes only if required; omit absent branch and reweight. No plan revision, approval or release is inferred; each actual later action is separately reviewed and mapped.
unknowns: How often are genuinely new comparison plans needed?
research_questions: Does hazard/scope indexing reduce actual locating effort before complete plan study?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes6 repeated plan-locating points minus0.5 upkeep=5.5. Low: a specialised hazard has only two known suitable comparison plans, so indexing removes just2 locating points while all verification and study remains;2 minus0.5=1.5. New notes and routine save produce no saving.
